text: HEAVEN SENT HEIR(01.21.26) Written by Justin Saucedo justin@lunarticks.comwww.lunarticks.com
INT. HOSPITAL - ETHAN'S ROOM - DAY1 1

ETHAN lies in bed, an oxygen mask over his face. Emily stands by his bedside, eyes red-rimmed, lookingat the DOCTOR, hugging herself, rubbing her arms, grieving. Her child, AVERY, stands behind her. EMILYWhen will my husband wake up? DOCTORYour attentive, meticulous care over the past eight years is why Noah is still alive. However... He puts away the chart, with a concerned expression DOCTOR (cont'd)The treatment to wake him up is another three hundred thousand dollars. Given your financial situation... EMILYI'm already drowning in debt. DOCTORNo one would blame you for if you stopped here. Emily tears up, forcing a casual smile. EMILYIt's okay. I'll just... I'll figure it out. The Doctor leaves. Emily steps forward, leans down close to Ethan, kisseshim, and cradles his face. EMILY (cont'd)(Softly)Noah, if you could wake up and see our son...(Tears welling up)I'd be the happiest woman alive. Emily straightens up and takes a pocket watch from

* ** * *** * * ** * ***** beside Ethan's pillow, puts it around Avery's neck, eyes reddening. EMILY (cont'd)Protect this. It's your father's most important possession. Avery nods. Emily stands up, looks at Ethan on the bed. EMILY (cont'd)I'm getting you out of here. I'll get the money and bring you back to life. Emily reaches out, puts her arms around Avery,takes one last look at Ethan, and leads Avery away. On the bed, Ethan's finger twitches slightly.
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT2 2

Monica sits on the sofa inside the house. The wall is covered with celebratory group photos from winning baseballgames. Trophies and medals are displayed on the shelves. Monica watches a recording on a large screen. She holds apocket watch in her hand, her fingers gently stroking it.

- YOUNG ETHAN (the actor playing Avery) swings at a pitch and sends it over the fence. - The crowd ROARS. - Monica, standing nearby, cheers and claps. - Monica hugs him, cups his face in her hands. MONICAEthan, darling, you're amazing!

Monica opens the car door and gets out. Anxious, she rushes toward Avery. Down the street, another car barrels around the corner. Emily comes out of the convenience store, sees the car coming. Monica turns, sees the car coming and freezes in shock. Seconds before impact, Emily runs to Monica, grabs her hand and pulls her to safety. They collapse on the ground. Avery runs to them.
EMILY(to Monica)Are you OK? Monica shakes her head, terrified. Then notices Avery coming toward her. She jumps to her feet. MONICAEthan! I'm here! Mommy found you!
Emily is shocked and confused. EMILYMa'am, you are mistaken. He is my child. Monica looks up, confused, then regains composure.

* * ** ** * **** ** ** MONICAYour child?(murmuring)Right, Ethan would be a grown-up now...(Shocked, V.O.)But he looks exactly like my Ethan when he was this age! Tears fall from Monica's eyes. AVERYMa'am, why are you sad? Monica is touched by his compassion. MONICASuch a good kid. Monica notices Avery's hands, bright red from cold. She looks at Avery's ragged clothes, then disapprovingly at Emily. MONICA (cont'd)It's winter! Why is he dressed like this? EMILY(embarrassed)I haven't been able to afford a new coat... Emily picks up the tattered job application. MONICAYou saved me today. I can offer you a job as a maid at my estate.(looks at Avery)And if your son wants to learn baseball, I'll coach him myself. Proper equipment, proper clothes, all of it. EMILY(excited)Really? I...thank you. You have no idea how much this means to us! MONICAYou saved me. I'll save you. Be warned though, my standards are high, my patience is short, and I don't tolerate mistakes.
**** * **** ** * ** ** EMILYI won't let you down!
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT4 4
LIAM and MAYA [SUBTITLE: Monica's Adopted Children] walk in, drenched. LIAM'S BODYGUARD 1 and LIAM'S BODYGUARD 2 follow.

* * *** * *** * * ** * **** ** * LIAMMom, it's been eight years! You're the only one who can coach our baseball team to victory. We need you back! MAYAWe know you miss Ethan, but without you, we're nothing! LIAMMother, please. Come back for the tournament. Monica's jaw tightens. MONICAEight years. And you still come to me empty handed, asking me to coach baseball? Liam steps forward. LIAMWe've spent hundreds of millions searching for him. We're close. A month, maybe less. We'll find him. MONICAYour promises mean nothing to me anymore.

Monica picks up a baseball bat, walks up to Liam, andswings it down fiercely towards Liam's leg. Liam lets out a sharp cry of pain, collapsing to theground, his face contorted in fury. Maya watches in horror. MONICA (cont'd)Seven days! If I don't see Ethan in seven days, you'd better have disappeared with him. Maya gulps nervously upon hearing this. MAYAWe'll find him, Mom. We'll find him. Maya, terrified, help Liam up and leave. After taking two steps--Liam looks back, still livid, at the LIAM'S BODYGUARD 1 and LIAM'S BODYGUARD 2 standing respectfully behind him.
** * ***** ** *** LIAMSend everyone we have. I don't care what it takes, find Ethan in seven days.

Emily walks alone in a dark alley. EMILY (V.O.)Eight years ago, I found Noah. Noah sits curled up, a wound on his forehead, in the alley. Emily approaches cautiously. EMILYAre you okay? Where do you live? What's your name? Ethan looks up at her weakly and shakes his head. ETHANI don't remember... EMILYYou need a doctor. I'm calling 911. MOTORCYCLE GUYHey, move it! Emily looks up and sees a motorcycle barreling toward her. Ethan reaches out and pulls Emily into his arms.
Emily, noticeably pregnant, walks towards their car withEthan by her side. Emily gently rubs her belly. EMILYOur baby is perfect. ETHANHe must look a lot like you.

* *** *** *** * Nearby, two MAFIOSOS pull up on a motorcycle. The one on the back (Mafioso 1) reaches out to snatch Emily's purse. Ethan steps forward bravely. ETHAN (cont'd)Get your hands off my wife! Mafioso 2 shoots Ethan. Ethan collapses in a pool of blood. Emily screams- EMILYNoah!

Emily wipes her eyes. EMILYHe's in a coma. I'm working three jobs just to pay for the treatment to wake him up. Emily covers her face and cries. MONICAThat's so sad. Monica hands a tissue to Emily. MONICA (cont'd)Do you have a photo of your husband? EMILYYes... MONICALet me talk to some acquaintances. I may be able to pull some strings. Emily takes a photo from inside her jacket layer andhands it to Monica. Monica is shocked.
EXT. CONVENIENCE STORE - DAY5 5

Emily, clutching a job application, reaches for the STORE OWNER'S hand. EMILYI'm begging you. Please, give me a chance. I NEED this job! Disgusted, the Store Owner shakes her off. STORE OWNERYou think I'm gonna let some negligent "mother" to drag her kid into MY store everyday! Not a chance! Get the fuck outta here! The Store Owner shoves Emily away, she stumbles and falls. From the ground she looks and sees Avery across the street. He didn't see what happened. Emily clenches her teeth and gets to her feet.
The photograph is yellowed, worn from years of handling. Monica studies it carefully.

**** * * * ** * **** *** **** * MONICA (cont'd)The photo's so faded... I wish I could see him better. Emily looks at the photo, puzzled. EMILYOh, sorry, let me get the other one. AS EMILY MOVES TO GET IT, MONICA STOPS HER WITH A GESTURE. MONICAAnother time, I have to go. Monica stands. MONICA (cont'd)If you need anything else, let me know. Emily is touched. EMILYThank you. Monica shrugs.

MONICAYou saved my life. This is nothing.(looks at Avery)Besides, the boy is exceptional. He deserves better than... your financial incompetence. Emily nods. Monica walks away. EMILY (V.O.)Monica has a sharp tongue and a good heart. After everything she's done for me... I have to work hard. I have to pay her back.
EXT. BASEBALL FIELD - FENCE - DAY6 6

Avery, dressed in ragged yellowed jacket, stands by the edge of a baseball field separated from the field by a wire fence, looking longingly at the players practicing inside. A car pulls up behind Avery and stops. Monica sits in the back seat. The window rolls down. She stares into the baseball field.
YOUNG ETHAN stands up with a proud expression. YOUNG ETHANI'm going to be the best baseball player in the world!
EXT. BASEBALL FIELD - FENCE - DAY8 8

A ball flies out of the field, Avery runs to catch it, heading straight toward Monica. Monica sees him. Freezes. Her eyes well up, her hand pressing on the car door handle as if to get out. MONICAEthan!!
EXT. MONICA'S HOUSE - ENTRANCE - DAY9 9

The car stops in front of the entrance to the estate. Emily and Avery climb out of the car and gape in awe at the estate. AVERYWhoa! Do we get to live in a castle? Monica stands next to them. Emily takes Avery's hand. The two of them stare in wonder at the fountain and luxury estate. Two rows of MAIDS stand in two lines and bow to Monica. MAIDSWelcome home, Ms Monica. Startled and nervous, Avery hides behind Emily. AVERYMom, this place is huge. How are you going to afford rent? MONICARent? Nobody is paying rent. Come inside, my dears. Assured, Avery gazes in wonder at the building. EMILY(softly)Avery, this is an extraordinary opportunity for all of us. A job for me. Elite baseball training for you. Listen to Ms Monica and don't misbehave! AVERY(nodding)Don't worry, Mom! Emily feels nervous, takes a deep steadying breath and leads the children inside.
The motorcycles stop. Cartel Guy 1 get off, whistling, pressing on Emily. Cartel Guy 1 snatches the bag fromEmily's hands. EMILY (cont'd)No! Give it back!!!

*** * ** * * Cartel Guy 1 cuts open the bag with a knife. She watches the precious cash falls out, scattering in the air and onto the ground. She phone drops down and hits the ground too. He grabs a handful of cash, looking amused-- CARTEL GUY 1I thought we caught a whale but you're just a guppy. Emily lunges forward desperately to collect the cash on the ground. EMILYI need that to save my husband! Give it back! As Emily tries, Cartel Guy 2 grabs her roughly. EMILY (cont'd)No! Let me go! Cartel Guy 2 shoves Emily towards Cartel Guy 3. Cartel Guy 3 squeezes Emily's butt. CARTEL GUY 3Wow! Nice ass! Emily watches a PASSERBY walking by on the street, her eyes pleading pitifully, helplessly. EMILYHelp me! Call the police! Please! The Passerby look afraid, lower their heads, and walk past. Emily watches their backs helplessly. EMILY (cont'd)No! Cartel Guy 3 holds Emily tightly, his greasy hand stroking her face. He kisses her cheek. CARTEL GUY 3Let's go to somewhere private.
He indicates the alley. EMILYNo! Leave me alone! Emily angrily bites Cartel Guy 3's hand.

** * * CARTEL GUY 3You bitch! You bit me?! Cartel Guy 3 looks at the wound on his hand, then slaps Emily twice! Emily cries out in pain. CARTEL GUY 3 (cont'd)Shut up! I'll deal with you later! Cartel Guy 3 throws Emily over his shoulder and carries her into the alley. EMILY(Struggling)Help!! Someone help me!
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY10 10
Emily is sweeping the floor. Monica takes out a cup of smoothie and hands it to Avery.

* **** **** * *** MONICAI brought you a snack. Work hard. You're a good kid. Avery isn't sure how to handle the generosity. AVERYI can't just take your food. How about we trade? Avery takes out a pack of white bread, opens it, and tears a chunk for Monica. Monica looks at the bread, shocked, her eyes turning red.She stands up, displeased, and looks at Emily. MONICAEmily! You're feeding your child this? Plain bread? How do you expect him to grow! Emily grips the broom tightly. EMILYIt's what I can afford... Avery tugs at Monica's clothes. AVERYMom barely eats. She gives me everything. Monica is perplexed. MONICA(to Emily)Where is the father? Why doesn't he provide for his family? AVERY(sad)Daddy didn't abandon us, he's sick and lives in the hospital! MONICA(confused)Sick? What's so severe that he's living in a hospital while his wife and child struggle to survive? Emily grips the broom tightly, a pained expression on herface.
* * ** * * EMILYThere was an accident. Eight years ago, when I found Noah, he had just been in an accident and lost his memory. MONICA(shocked)What?

Hands trembling, Monica makes a phone call. Maya and Liam show up in a split-screen, receiving the call in different locations. MONICA (cont'd)Go to Juarez. Find my daughter-in-law, Emily, and bring her home! MAYA/LIAMYes Ma'am!!
The three Cartel Guys squint, sizing up Liam and Maya. CARTEL GUY 3Who the hell are you? Can't you see I'm busy here?

*** ** * Cartel Guy 3 raises the bottle, aiming to throw it at Liam. Liam's Bodyguard 1 intercepts, kicking him away. Cartel Guy 3 staggers from the kick, supported by Cartel Guy 1 and 2. Maya looks down at the three with disdain. MAYASeize them! Liam's Bodyguard 1 and Liam's Bodyguard 2 swarm forward, backs the three cartel guys into the deep alleyway. Liam walks towards Emily in the corner, takes off his coat, drapes it over Emily. LIAMEmily, are you alright? Emily shakes her head, shrinking back slightly with somewariness. Cartel Guy 2 breaks free from a Liam's Bodyguard 1, pulls asmall knife from his pocket, and points it at the group. MAYAYou think that scares me? Maya swiftly disarms and restrains Cartel Guy 2. Cartel Guy 2's face contorts in pain. CARTEL GUY 2Let go of me! Maya forcefully presses him against the wall, taking theknife from his hand. CARTEL GUY 2 (cont'd)(afraid)What are you doing? Cartel Guy 2 struggles but Maya has him immobilized. She presses Cartel Guy 2's right hand against the wall, raises the knife, and plunges it through. CARTEL GUY 2 (cont'd)(screams)Ahh---! Cartel Guy 2 slides down the wall, collapsing to the ground. Cartel Guy 1 and 3 look horrified. CARTEL GUY 1(terrified)Who the hell are you people?!
** ** ** Maya adjusts her clothes, looks up at Cartel Guy 1. MAYAThe Thompson family. Cartel Guy 1 and 3 look terrified upon hearing this. CARTEL GUY 1What?!

Cartel Guy 1 and 3 turn pale. Cartel Guy 2 backs away. CARTEL GUY 3(ingratiating)The Thompson family! What are you doing in a place like this? CARTEL GUY 1Look, it's misunderstanding, yeah? We'll just go, alright? The two Cartel Guys try to leave but are stopped by the two bodyguards. MAYAWho gave you permission to leave? Cartel Guy 3 glances at Emily in the corner, putting on aningratiating, fearful smile. CARTEL GUY 3(ingratiating, wary)Alright, take her. The worn-out whore is yours. Maya punches Cartel Guy 3 in the face. MAYAShut your mouth! LIAMShe's married to the Thompson heir! Emily looks up at Liam in shock. CARTEL GUY 1(in disbelief)You can't be serious! She's a nobody working in a Juarez bar!

* ** * CARTEL GUY 3Yeah, who knows how many men have had her-- Before Cartel Guy 3 can finish, Liam pulls out a gun and fires a shot into Cartel Guy 3's groin. CARTEL GUY 3 (cont'd)(screams)Ahh---!! Cartel Guy 3 collapses to his knees in agony. Cartel Guy 1 sees this, turns deathly pale, staggering back fearfully. LIAMWanna keep slandering a member of the Thompson family?! Cartel Guy 1 is terrified, puts his hands together in supplication, kneels, and looks up at Liam. CARTEL GUY 1No, this is a misunderstanding! I didn't do anything! Please, let me go! Liam and Maya remain silent. Cartel Guy 1 then turns and kneels towards Emily. CARTEL GUY 1 (cont'd)Miss, it's all our fault! We'll never bother you again! I'm sorry! EMILYYou won't bother me again, but what about the next poor girl who crosses your path? Emily turns her head away. Liam kicks Cartel Guy 1. LIAMTake him away! LIAM'S BODYGUARD 2Yes, sir. Cartel Guy 1 struggles as the bodyguards drag him away.
The car is driving. Emily, pale, wrapped in a coat, sits in the back seat.Maya sits beside Emily and hands her a photograph.

* *** It's a group photo of the Thompson family. Emily's fingers trace Ethan's face in the photo. EMILYWhy is Noah in this picture? MAYAYour husband's real name is Ethan Thompson. He is the heir of the Thompson family. And our brother. EMILYWhat... MAYAEight years ago, during a baseball tournament, Ethan's rivals set him up and he went missing. Thanks to you, we finally found him. You have no idea how much we missed him. Especially Monica. EMILYMonica is my... Maya takes Emily's hand. MAYAShe's your mother-in-law. EMILYI can't believe this is true. No wonder she likes Avery so much...
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - STUDY - DAY14 14

Various bats, baseballs, gloves, and protective gear aredisplayed on shelves in Monica's room. Emily carefully dusts the shelves. A baseball placed in the very center with Ethan's signature on it! Curious, she takes it down to examine, gently traces the handwriting.

Avery rushes forward and hugs Emily. AVERYMom! Monica steps forward, anxiously checking on Emily. MONICAEmily, are you okay? Are you hurt? Emily pats Monica’s arm reassuringly. EMILYI’m fine. Thanks to them. MONICAOh thank god! Monica holds Emily’s hand. MONICA (cont'd)Emily, I treated you so terribly! I'm so sorry. Without you, Ethan wouldn’t be alive today... EMILYNoah—no, Ethan— is my husband. I love him. I would do anything for him. Monica nods with relief.

** * * * MONICAYou went through so much all those years. Emily shakes her head, suddenly thinking of something. EMILYSince Ethan is part of the Thompson family, does that mean his medical bills will be covered? MONICAOf course. Avery is delighted. AVERYThat’s awesome! Daddy's waking up! EMILYMonica, I really don’t know how to thank you. Monica hugs Emily. MONICAAlright, Emily. Get some rest. Tomorrow, we'll bring Ethan home together. Emily nods immediately. Just as she is about to leave, her phone receives a debt-collection text message. Emily transfers the money, turns off the phone, and follows Monica.
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - STUDY - DAY16 16

EMILY(To herself)This handwriting...why is it so similar to Noah's? Monica enters from behind and sees what Emily is doing. Her face changes dramatically. MONICAWhat are you doing?! Emily is startled. The baseball drops from her hands, which snaps her back to reality. She immediately tries to pick it up, but Monica reaches it first, examining it nervously. EMILYI'm sorry! The handwriting looked familiar--
Young Ethan swinging a bat and crushing a ball.
Rebecca is shocked. REBECCALucy? Victor?
SUPER: Eight years earlier.
Emily kneels on the ground, begging Lucy and Victor. EMILYNoah needs an emergency surgery. I beg you, please loan me the money to save him! Lucy and Victor exchange a malicious look.

Emily stands up and moves toward the door, trying to drive them out of the ward. EMILYI’ve already paid you this month’s money. You promised you'd leave me alone! Get out! Victor shoves Emily aside and slaps her. Emily collapses onto the floor. VICTORWho gave you the right to speak to me with that tone? LUCY(mocking, shrugging)Yeah. Don’t forget— you came to us(MORE)

** LUCY (cont'd)begging for money. Begging like a whipped dog! EMILYWhat do you want?! VICTORThe rest of the money! All two hundred thousand. Not a dime less! Emily’s face changes drastically. She suddenly looks up, supports herself on the ground, and struggles to stand. EMILYTwo hundred thousand? I borrowed fifty thousand. I've been repaying on time! Even with interest, it can't be two-hundred thousand. Lucy sneers, crossing her arms. LUCYOh? Didn't you know? The interest compounds daily. Victor steps closer to Emily. VICTOREnough talk. Pay up today. Otherwise...(looks toward Ethan on the bed)...we'll loan you money for his funeral. Emily immediately blocks Victor’s line of sight, standing protectively in front of Ethan. EMILYNo! You can’t do this! Victor grabs Emily's face. VICTOR(viciously)Then hand over the money! Now!
Emily struggles in agony. EMILYI gave you all the money I have!

* * * LUCYWhy are you lying! Lucy looks around, scanning the room. LUCY (cont'd)You put Mr. Cauliflower in a sweet-ass room like this and have the nerve to tell us you have no money? Victor grabs Emily by the hair. VICTORYeah, Emily, do we look stupid to you? EMILYNo, I'm not lying-- Victor loses patience and throws Emily to the ground. VICTORFine. If you don't want to tell the truth, we'll make you tell us the truth. Victor and Lucy exchange a look. Lucy understands, takes out her phone, opens a live stream, and points it at Emily. LUCYEveryone, come see what we got here. This bitch isn't paying her debts! Victor, let them see her face! Victor grabs Emily triumphantly, forcing her head up. EMILY(Struggling)No, I paid! Let me go! VICTORCome on, Emily, stop moving. Pay up now and maybe we'll let you off the hook. Lucy looks at the live stream interface, bullet comments scroll by. BULLET COMMENT 1 (V.O.)Her mouth writing checks her ass can't cash! BULLET COMMENT 2 (V.O.)Bitch is hot tho...

*** * * *** BULLET COMMENT 3 (V.O.)I'm sure there are other ways to make her pay (fire emoji)(peach emoji)! Lucy looks at the comments and reveals a smug smile. LUCY(Playful)Alright, calm down everyone, I know what you want to see. Victor, satisfy our followers, strip her. Show them what a cheap ass whore looks like. Victor shows a playful smile. VICTORWhat a brilliant idea! LUCY(to the camera)Remember to like and subscribe! Victor reaches to take off Emily's clothes. Emily looks horrified. EMILYNo, stop! Don't do this!

Monica is dressed luxuriously. Avery sits beside Monica. Liam sits in the passenger seat. Liam looks at the live stream on his phone, shocked. He turns and hands the phone to Monica. LIAMEmily is in trouble! Monica takes the phone to look, her face changes drops. MONICA(angry)Faster! Whoever messes with Emily messes with ME!
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - STUDY - DAY18 18

MONICAThis is my son's! Get your filthy hands off of it! You've no idea how important this is to me! EMILYI'm sorry, I didn't mean to. Monica slaps Emily across the face. MONICAGet out! You are not allowed to enter this house ever again! Monica shoves her toward the door.

* *** ** *** *** ** * ** EMILY(voice trembling)Monica, I'm really sorry. Monica shoves Emily roughly. Emily staggers back, loses her balance. Her ankle rolls underneath her as she crashes to the ground. She winces, gripping her ankle.
INT. MONICA'S HOUSE - STUDY - LATER19 19
Monica closes the door, sits on the sofa, and carefullystrokes the baseball, choking up. MONICAEthan, where are you?

Victor and Lucy stare at the door in shock. Monica's expression is dark as she motions to her bodyguards. MONICA (cont'd)Seize these psychotic monsters! Monica's Bodyguard 1 and Monica's Bodyguard 2 step forward, subduing Victor and Lucy. One snatches Lucy's phone and smashes it on the floor. LUCYHey, that's expensive! VICTORLet me go! Avery rushes forward. AVERYMom! Emily hugs him close, kissing and comforting him as if surviving a disaster. LUCY(Shrill)Emily, you coward! I can't believe you called for backup. Monica shields Emily.

** Maya slaps Lucy backhanded. MAYAWatch your filthy mouth or I'll cut out your tongue! LUCYWho are you people? I'm warning you, stay out of our business! MONICAEmily is part of the Thompson family. So, naturally, this matter concerns all of us. Lucy and Victor's expressions change drastically. VICTORThe Thompson family? No, that's impossible! She was begging us to save her useless husband. Why would a Thompson do that? LUCYAre you sure you have the right person? MONICAAre you questioning me? Victor and Lucy exchange a glance, their faces turning deathly pale. They immediately drop to their knees, hitting the floor hard. Pleading, voices trembling. VICTORMa'am, please, we didn't know she was a Thompson! Nobody told us! LUCYPlease spare us! MONICATake them away! Monica waves a hand. The two bodyguards understand and start dragging Victor and Lucy away. Victor and Lucy are terrified, grabbing Emily's arm. LUCYEmily! Emily, you can't do this to us! When you were begging for loans everywhere, we were the only ones who helped you!

** * * *** ** * VICTORYou still owe us money! Emily shakes off Lucy's hand. EMILYI will find a way to repay that money, but that is no excuse for abusing me in front of my husband! MONICAGet rid of them! The bodyguards haul Victor and Lucy away. They wear expressions of sheer terror.
EXT. MONICA'S HOUSE - ENTRANCE - DAY20 20

Emily holds Avery's hand, looking at her son, slightly nervous. EMILY (V.O.)What have I done? Monica won't coach Avery anymore. And it's my fault... Monica comes out, her face stern. She hands candy toAvery. MONICAYou did well today. This is your reward. Avery glance at Emily. Emily gives a slight nod. Avery excitedly accepts. AVERYThanks, Coach! Emily nods her head slightly. EMILYThank you for the lesson. We won't bother you again. Emily turns to go, limping. Monica watches her. MONICAWait.

*** *** * * ** ********** ** Emily turns, puzzled, to look at Monica. Monica tosses a tube pain relief cream to Emily. MONICA (cont'd)For your ankle. Emily catches it, surprised. MONICA (cont'd)Avery has practice tomorrow and you have things to dust. Don't be late. EMILY(in disbelief)You'll keep coaching him? Monica gives her a sidelong glance. MONICAWhy? Do you want him to quit? Emily is overjoyed and flustered. EMILYNo... I mean, thank you so much! Monica gives her a sidelong glance, turns, and leaves. MONICAI told you I don't waste talent. Goodbye.

The bodyguards haul Lucy and Victor away. Monica reaches out and takes Emily's hand. MONICA (cont'd)Emily, all these years, you suffered so much. EMILY(shaking her head)It was nothing. MONICA(looking at Liam)Liam, payoff the lunatics. I don't want to see them again. LIAMYes. Liam and Maya walk out. Monica's gaze shifts to Ethan. She reaches out and holds his hand. MONICA(choked up)My son... I finally found you. EMILY(Comfortingly)The doctor said the surgery was successful. He'll wake up soon. MONICAThank God! Monica looks at Emily and takes her hand.

***** * ** * ** **** **** MONICA (cont'd)Emily, we owe you everything. You saved Ethan. You raised this wonderful boy on your own. I promise you, no one will ever hurt you again. Not while I'm here. Emily nods. Avery steps forward and hugs Emily. AVERYI'll protect Mommy too! Emily looks at Avery with relief. Monica smiles. MONICAWonderful. Emily, let's take Ethan home together. Emily nods.
INT. HOSPITAL - ETHAN'S ROOM - DAY21 21

Emily and Avery walk to the bed where Ethan lies unconscious. Emily takes Ethan's hand, smiling. EMILYNoah, I met this... interesting woman today. She knows baseball and she's coaching Avery now. She's helping us. I wish you were here. You'd want to thank her too. As Emily speaks, Ethan's eyelid twitches. Emily doesn't notice. She places Ethan's hand against her cheek. EMILY (cont'd)When will you wake up? We miss you. The electronic monitor beside them beeps an alarm.
* * Emily looks nervous. EMILY (cont'd)Noah, what's wrong? Noah!

Emily and Monica, holding Avery's hand. Avery looks around in amazement. AVERYOh my god, this place is huge! It could fit a baseball field! MONICA(smiling)A baseball field inside is silly. If you want one, we'll build it outside. Emily immediately waves her hands in refusal. EMILYNo! That's far too extravagant! Monica smiles. Not far away, two butlers approach pushing mobile display stands covered with deep red velvet cloth.

* *** * * ***** ** * Liam and Maya follow closely behind. AVERYGrandma, what's this? MONICA(smiling)I had these made especially for you. Monica lifts the first cloth, revealing two pairs of limited edition, custom-made baseball gloves. Avery's eyes widen in surprise and delight. AVERYThese are really for me? MONICAOf course. Hand-stitched by master artisans. Completely unique, you won't find another one anywhere. AVERYThis is amazing! Thank you, Grandma! Maya stands to the side, smiling. MAYAYou think that's special. Kiddo, come see what I've got for you. Maya lifts the second cloth, revealing a custom-made baseball uniform. MAYA (cont'd)This uniform is made from experimental high-tech material. It'll optimize your performance on the field. AVERY(excited)Can I wear them when I play! Like superheroes?
MONICAYou deserve nothing less. Avery excitedly hug Monica. AVERYThis is great! Thank you, Grandma! Emily watches Avery with a smile in her eyes.
* * * ** * ** * ** * MONICAOf course. These gifts are just the beginning. Monica looks at Emily. MONICA (cont'd)Now, Emily, let's go shopping. Whatever you want, it's yours.
INT. HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAY22 22

Emily sits on a bench in the long corridor with Avery, her hands covering her face as she cries. The Doctor comes out. Emily steps up anxiously. EMILYDoctor, how is he?! DOCTORHe's deteriorating. The surgery can't wait any longer. EMILYWhat? DOCTORPayment for this treatment is up front. You have seven days to get three hundred thousand dollars. Emily staggers back a few steps, looking dazed.
EXT. STREET - DAY23 23

Emily, followed by Avery, walks down the street in a traumatized daze. EMILY (V.O.)Three hundred thousand dollars. Noah, how could I ever earn that kind of money? Emily sees a small flyer by the street advertising"High Paid Work" with a contact number. EMILY(murmuring)Hiring service staff? Earn three hundred thousand dollars in just one week? Emily thinks for a moment, then comes to a decision. She takes out her phone and dials.
